editionProposal.label: BPA 2025 Transmission Plan, index update August 25, 2026
editionProposal.caveat: Index update is not an asserted original publication date; GERP secondary data have their own snapshot dates.

enumerationProposal.status: requires coordinator acceptance of grouping and alias rules
enumerationProposal.countMeaning: Curated full-plan normalization universe, not all textual mentions or a publisher count of distinct engineering projects. Repeated narrative/CAP mentions attach evidence to these units. Combined completed source bundles remain combined.
sourceSections: 1.2.1 new CAPs and short-circuit breaker needs
notProjects: unnamed potential route connections or series capacitors subordinate to named projects
conditional study options without a separately named adopted project

geometryReview.policy: Use public geometry only after an explicit source-specific linkage and role decision. No point/polyline centroid generation, geocoding or inference that a current facility represents an entire proposal. Polylines are outside current Point/MultiPoint runtime type; preserve them as source evidence, not forced point records.
